reporting-org.narrative: FMO NV (Nederlandse Financierings-Maatschappij voor Ontwikkelingslanden N.V.)

description.narrative: The lack of access to basic resources in the local community of Morrope (declared as being in extreme poverty) such as water and energy for hygiene, and the lack of appropriate medical care could endanger the most vulnerable. For that reason, the following strategies will be implemented: 1. Information campaign to provide updated and objective information to the community of Morrope about recommendations on COVID-19, health plans of the Government, basic protocols to follow, self-protection, changes in social activities/way of life, updates on the pandemic in the Lambayeque Region, etc. 2. Support for the health centre of Morrope with equipment and materials to provide medical services to the community. 3. Donation of drinking water.
